text:
I need to verify if Donovan wrote "Here Comes My Baby" for the Tremeloes at age 18.

"Here Comes My Baby" was indeed recorded by the Tremeloes and was a hit for them in 1967. The song was written by Cat Stevens (now known as Yusuf Islam), not Donovan. Cat Stevens wrote this song when he was around 18 years old, in 1966-67.

Donovan is a different English singer-songwriter from the same era, known for hits like "Mellow Yellow" and "Sunshine Superman."

Verdict: INCORRECT
Confidence: 0.98
